ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, fold the corner where vertex D of rectangle ABCD is located, so that point D falls on point F on side BC, with the crease being AE. If $\angle DAE=25^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle EFC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: \textbf{Solution}: As shown in the figure, since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rectangle, thus $AD \parallel BC$ and $\angle D=90^\circ$. By folding, it is known that $\triangle ADE \cong \triangle AFE$. Therefore, $\angle FAE=\angle DAE=25^\circ$, and $\angle AFE=\angle D=90^\circ$. Therefore, $\angle AFB=\angle DAF=2\angle DAE=50^\circ$. Therefore, $\angle EFC=180^\circ-\angle AFB-\angle AFE=180^\circ-50^\circ-90^\circ=\boxed{40^\circ}$.
